## OGE Energy Corp. third quarter 2026 earnings webcast


September 29, 2026


[PDF Version](https://ogeenergy.gcs-web.com/node/45786/pdf)


OKLAHOMA CITY


, Sept. 29, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- OGE Energy Corp. (NYSE: OGE) will hold its quarterly earnings and business update conference call at 9 a.m. Eastern Time (8 a.m. Central Time), Wednesday, October 28, 2026.


This call is being webcast by Notified and can be accessed at OGE Energy's website at[www.oge.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4785841-1&h=107951525&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.oge.com%2Fweb%2Fportal%2Flabel_ord%2Finvestors%2Fnews-events&a=www.oge.com) .
